external_gates.requirement: Configure the four public Shopify App Pricing plans on the Live app only.
Use the Partner API client for Live app pricing/subscription verification. Dev and Staging do not depend on Partner API billing reads.
Enter the prepared English listing copy in Partner Dashboard and upload compliant actual UI media/screenshots.
Configure the Partner account emergency developer contact.
Complete any protected customer data declarations required by the submission form.
Enter the prepared reviewer instructions/test-store steps and attach the required demo screencast.
Pass Shopify submission automated checks before submitting for review.
Submit the completed app for Shopify review.
After the accepted release, run Final Production Merchant Smoke and record PASS evidence.

partner_api_runtime.identifiers_source: Partner Dashboard / successful Shopify CLI evidence

test_strategy.local_dev: Use Dev app with Billing API test subscriptions.
test_strategy.staging: Use Staging app with Billing API test subscriptions.
test_strategy.live_app_pricing: Install the Live app on a Partner development store and select each public Shopify App Pricing plan at no charge before submission.
